domain_title: Models, agents, providers, tools and supply chain
title: Vendor assurance substitution
canonical_definition: Vendor claims, certifications or marketing are treated as proof that the integrated system is governed.

conditions: Systems using third-party models, hosting, tools, data services, evaluators or managed AI components.
Record the assessed release, operating scope and evidence that supports any applicability decision.

primary_questions.question: Does the case exhibit Vendor assurance substitution: Vendor claims, certifications or marketing are treated as proof that the integrated system is governed.
Do implemented workflows, data paths or operations show enterprise-grade used as evidence, assumed transfer of provider compliance, or missing exit plans?
Does current evidence test presence or scoped absence of Vendor assurance substitution, or does it remain unknown?

antipattern_indicators: Provider compliance is assumed to transfer
No exit plan or term-change monitoring

conditions: Refer verified vendor assurance substitution to the accountable authority before progression where the condition materially affects the requested operating scope.

normative_source_mappings.relevant_locator: NIST AI 100-1, GOVERN 6.1 (PDF p. 29), GOVERN 6.2 (PDF p. 29), MANAGE 3.1 (PDF p. 37)
normative_source_mappings.mapping_rationale: The voluntary framework provides guidance on third-party risk policies, contingency and monitoring. The SAE criteria define the object-specific rules. Confirm any binding obligation through the accountable authority and its applicable source.

failure_mechanism: The declared or implemented control can be unreliable where vendor certifications or marketing are accepted as system-specific assurance without integration review. The mechanism can have an operational effect where observed provider settings conflict with the contract, a material change has no owner, or the exit route cannot be exercised.
potential_consequences: Provider changes or failures may leave the integrated service outside its approved operating conditions.

atomic_tests.test: Compare the effective governance and design records. Determine whether vendor certifications or marketing are accepted as system-specific assurance without integration review. Identify the system scope and the record that supports each conclusion.

Trace actual configurations or activity for the assessed release. Determine whether observed provider settings conflict with the contract, a material change has no owner, or the exit route cannot be exercised. Attribute each observation to the specific path, time and decision.

Independently review an integration-level evidence review with provider notification, continuity and data exit exercises. Record whether each material mechanism was tested, the observed result and the scope limitations.

required_evidence.title: Effective design and governance records
required_evidence.description: Review the versioned owner decision and relevant specifications for evidence of whether vendor certifications or marketing are accepted as system-specific assurance without integration review. Preserve material conflict and applicability context.

required_evidence.title: Observed condition or enforcement trace
required_evidence.description: Use effective configuration or dated operational records to determine whether observed provider settings conflict with the contract, a material change has no owner, or the exit route cannot be exercised. Identify the version, affected paths and period represented.

required_evidence.title: Executed scoped comparison
required_evidence.description: Provide an integration-level evidence review with provider notification, continuity and data exit exercises. Include current scope, expected results, observed results, retained evidence and unresolved cases.

required_evidence.title: Independent review and limitations
required_evidence.description: An independent reviewer confirms the assessed version, completeness of coverage, result, limitations and whether a material change requires a new test.

required_artifacts: An integration-level evidence review with provider notification, continuity and data exit exercises.
Current version and scope with all material failure paths and cases identified.
Expected and observed results, attributable records, and independent review of coverage and residual limitations.

sufficiency: Presence requires affirmative evidence for a material mechanism. Examine whether vendor certifications or marketing are accepted as system-specific assurance without integration review, and separately check whether observed provider settings conflict with the contract, a material change has no owner, or the exit route cannot be exercised. A supported mechanism may establish presence within its evidenced scope.
Keep unresolved or contradictory mechanisms UNKNOWN and preserve the competing records. Refer material interpretation conflicts to the accountable human authority.

Use TESTED_ABSENT only after a current, executed, successful and independently verified evaluation covers all material paths within scope. Use an integration-level evidence review with provider notification, continuity and data exit exercises. Reassess when material changes affect that scope.
evidence_rules.evidence_ceiling: A document can identify a declared gap. Effective configuration can demonstrate a reachable condition. Observed records support only their covered period and workflow. TESTED_ABSENT requires the complete scoped absence contract.
false_positive_guards: A provider attestation can support a narrowly identified dependency claim within its verified scope.
Confirm that the observed or alleged condition applies to the current assessed release and a reachable path.
prohibited_inferences: A gap or UNKNOWN in C4 alone cannot establish AP-C4 presence.
Missing complaints, incident silence and unsuccessful collection cannot establish absence.
Model output and tactic selection grant no authority to approve, close a finding or accept risk.

finding_definitions.title: Design or intent shows vendor assurance substitution
Implementation or operating evidence shows vendor assurance substitution
Presence or tested absence of vendor assurance substitution is unresolved within scope
